description:
FILED s539c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15).  Observed ONCE: the s539c full gate (PCLXS_DIR=~/pclxs tools/prove-core in the worktree agent-ade4d9bd1dff36571, tree b050c882 = MAIN-READY-95 cc36604b + PPI batch 9, generation v2-14900, the first gate of that generation, so every module of the gate compiled cold; box load ~12 with three sibling legs) -- Files=377 Tests=12,265, ONE failure:

    Pl/t/use-base-phase-01.t row 2  `use base` inside `BEGIN { package X; }` pushes X's @ISA, and X->new resolves
    got: 'Heap exhausted during garbage collection: 3984 bytes available, 4112 requested. ... [93.0% of 1073741824 max]'

The log: scratch/s539c/gate.log in that worktree.

NOT reproduced: the file ALONE passes with a FRESH PCL_CACHE_DIR on the main extraction cc36604b AND on the batch tree (scratch/s539c/cold2.out), and warm on the tree.  The difference is the concurrency of the full gate on a cold cache: several gate files compile Pod::Simple and its dependencies at the same time, and since MAIN-READY-95 (s540d: every module compiled once, a module first loaded while another is compiled gets its compiled file in the same run) the path a process takes depends on what a sibling has finished -- one of those paths peaks above the 1 GB dynamic space.  The batch's own change cannot reach it (Pod::Simple's sources hold no CR; the PPI groups change no file of the gate population -- wide A/B 2,052 of 2,053 SAME vs cc36604b).

Cheap discriminating measurement: run the full gate twice on a fresh generation (or with PCL_CACHE_DIR fresh for the whole gate) on main itself; if row 2 dies there too, it is main's cold-cache peak; then measure the row's peak heap cold alone vs cold under `prove -j8` with a sibling compiling Pod::Simple (PCL_SHOW_SBCL=1 gives the command; --dynamic-space-size shows whether 1 GB is the limit).  The s539c re-run of the full gate on a warm cache is gate2.log.


MEASURED by the reviewing session (s542, at the s539c merge): the FULL gate on merged main MAIN-READY-97 (code c1fe4930, v2-14900) with a FRESH `PCL_CACHE_DIR` (0 entries at the start, 122 MB at the end), load 12-15 with three siblings' legs: **Result: PASS, 378 files / 12,283 rows** (`~/pcl-agent-scratch/s542/merge/c9-cold.log`).  So the cold-cache peak is NOT deterministic: one failure in the batch's first gate, zero in this cold gate.  Stays open as a flake to watch: if a gate or CI shows `Heap exhausted` in a file that compiles Pod::Simple, the next measurement is the row's peak heap under `prove -j8` beside a sibling compiling the same module (s540d's deferred fasl build, #4963, decides which process compiles).
subject: GATE FLAKE: Pl/t/use-base-phase-01.t row 2 (`use base` inside `BEGIN { package X; }` + Pod::Simple::XHTML) died "Heap exhausted during garbage collection" in a FULL gate run with the module cache COLD for a new generation; the file passes alone, cold and warm, on main and on the batch tree
